name: v1.110.2
body:
## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.2
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.110.2

11 PRs. 8 fixed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Anthropic:** Fixed `temperature=1` returning 400 on Claude models that removed sampling params on Anthropic, Vertex AI and Azure AI, broken since v1.110.0-rc.2 (#52341)
- **Responses API:** Fixed streams retrying after output reached the client, which sent duplicate events and billed extra calls (#52461)
- **Responses API:** Fixed streams that fail after reasoning output restarting on a fallback group and sending a second response (#52616)
- **Caching:** Fixed GPT-6.2 system prompts missing the prompt cache on `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/messages` unless `store: false` (#52906) <sup>Also in [1.106.12](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.106.12), [1.108.13](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.13), [1.109.3](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.3)</sup>
- **Cost tracking and pricing:** Fixed forwarded Anthropic credentials on `/v1/messages` ignoring the deployment's custom prices, broken since v1.109.0 (#52313)
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Fixed JWT key mappings without `jwt_issuer` taking 5 minutes to apply when `litellm_jwtauth.issuers` is set, broken since v1.103.0 (#52350) <sup>Also in [1.108.13](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.13), [1.109.3](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.3)</sup>
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Fixed `/key/info` letting a key with no user read other userless keys by hash or alias (#52838, #52925) <sup>Also in [1.106.12](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.106.12), [1.108.13](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.13), [1.109.3](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.3)</sup>
- **Performance:** Fixed memory growth from every finished request staying in memory until a full GC pass, broken since v1.110.0-rc.1 (#51888)

---
